correctness.rationale: Exact rational-function proof covers all finite positive cases (11 graph orders, 60 symmetry-reduced entries) via integral polynomial coefficient certificates and exact symbolic inversion; fifth-order Taylor coefficient 1/108 times negative shortest five-walk term gives rigorous small-step failures for all larger orders. Q(h) is positive definite for h>=0; stochasticity follows from R(0)=1 and L1=0.

evidence: Bolley–Crouzeix (1978), Lemma 1/Theorem 1, excludes universally positive order≥2 one-step methods *over all positive parabolic generators*; it does not imply that any specified fixed small graph fails, nor give positive exceptions.
Horváth–Song–Terlaky (2014), section 3.2, derives sufficient step-length threshold from rational radius of absolute monotonicity; it is not an all-step graph-order equivalence.

The complete-multipartite result covers only the triangle and four-cycle among simple cycles; it neither settles cycles of lengths five through nine nor the longer-cycle obstruction, and it does not cover paths with four or five vertices.
